uncultured.status: METHOD CORRECTION · CAPTURE DATE ≠ DRIVE DATE
uncultured.finding: Two raw camera images carry filename dates in 2025 while Drive metadata records them as created/uploaded in August 2026. Drive creation time cannot be treated as capture time. Visual chronology must prefer camera/filename/EXIF evidence where available and keep upload time separate.
uncultured.next: continue testing whether the apparent recurring interest in surfaces/mediation survives after chronology is corrected

terminus.finding: The sampled Drive documents are clearly third-party/reference materials: a 2012 Dadaocheng/story-tourism presentation credited to 水瓶子 and a Kinmen National Park commissioned evaluation executed by National Kinmen Institute of Technology. Their concepts may be mined as sources, but must not be counted as evidence of the user's own conceptual lineage.
terminus.candidate: Terminus needs provenance stratification before concept-linking: authored-by-user / coauthored / notes-or-excerpts / third-party reference / generated-or-reconstructed. Cross-document patterns must carry the provenance class.
terminus.next: sample older documents with mixed provenance and test whether previously identified long-term concept lines remain valid when only user-authored/coauthored strata are counted

phase: small-batch validation; provenance and chronology now treated as first-class mining constraints
